item.title: [看到华为三星折叠机受关注后，库克推动苹果加速研发折叠屏 iPhone] After Seeing Huawei and Samsung Foldables Gain Attention, Cook Pushes Apple to Accelerate Foldable iPhone R&D
item.guid: 看到华为三星折叠机受关注后，库克推动苹果加速研发折叠屏-iPhone
item.description:
According to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman, Apple's journey to develop a foldable iPhone has spanned nearly a decade. The device is expected to cost over $2,000, marking Apple's biggest design change in nearly 20 years.

The report reveals that Apple's focus on foldable devices dates back to around 2020. At that time, Apple CEO Tim Cook showed an unusually positive attitude towards the emerging category of foldable phones after an Asia trip.

During his visits to Asian regions, including China, Tim Cook observed an increasing number of consumers using foldable devices from manufacturers like Samsung Electronics and Huawei. This observation convinced him that Apple must launch its own foldable product, and he immediately pushed the company to accelerate its R&D efforts in this emerging market.

item.title: [OpenAI 发布 Navier–Stokes 千禧年难题候选解，等待数学界检验] OpenAI Releases Candidate Solution for Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, Awaiting Mathematical Community Review
item.guid: OpenAI-发布-Navier–Stokes-千禧年难题候选解，等待数学界检验
item.description:
On September 8, OpenAI announced a candidate solution to the Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness problem, along with a mathematical paper and a Lean formal proof. The company states that this proof provides a construction for the formation of singularities in smooth three-dimensional incompressible fluids within a finite time, corresponding to cases C and D in the Clay Mathematics Institute's problem statement.

OpenAI claims the proof was completed by an internal model with capabilities superior to GPT-6 Astra, with the system coordinating approximately 10,000 concurrent agents at one point. It took about 88 hours from initiation to obtaining the candidate solution, followed by GPT-6 Astra spending 17 hours to complete the Lean formalization and verification; the Navier–Stokes project generated approximately 2.7 million agent messages and 130 billion output tokens.

This work also brought up a concurrent controversy regarding Euler equation research. Tristan Buckmaster, a mathematics professor at New York University, questioned whether OpenAI had used project data from his work with Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge in Codex. OpenAI stated that the solving process did not access specific user data but could not completely rule out the possibility that de-identified usage data had contributed to model improvements; the problems addressed by the proofs publicly released by both parties are also not identical.

This candidate solution has not yet undergone independent verification by the global mathematical community. According to Clay Mathematics Institute rules, a solution must first be published in a qualified publication and undergo at least two years of rigorous review and widespread acceptance before being considered for an award. OpenAI stated it has no intention of applying for an award for this result.

🔗 Related reading: Just now, OpenAI announced it had solved a Millennium Prize Problem, Tsinghua Yao Class legend Chen Lijie: An incredible era

item.title: [DeepSeek Flash 系列 9 月 10 日起降价，V4.1 Flash 同步开启内测] DeepSeek Flash Series Price Reduction Starting September 10, V4.1 Flash Internal Testing Begins Simultaneously
item.guid: DeepSeek-Flash-系列-9-月-10-日起降价，V4.1-Flash-同步开启内测
item.description:
DeepSeek will significantly adjust the pricing of its Flash series models starting at 12:00 on September 10. Off-peak input prices will drop from 1.5 yuan per million tokens to 1 yuan, off-peak output prices from 4.5 yuan to 4 yuan, and off-peak cache prices from 0.05 yuan to 0.02 yuan; peak-time prices will be double the off-peak prices.

Concurrently, internal testing for the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash intermediate version has begun. API users participating in the internal test do not need to change their base_url; they can call the model by switching the model name to "deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910". Current billing is the same as DeepSeek V4 Flash, with a maximum of 20 concurrent requests per account.

The expiration date in this model ID is September 10, indicating a short-term internal test version that has not yet replaced the official V4 Flash model in the API documentation. The new version uses a different model architecture, natively supports multimodal capabilities, and this round of testing focuses on capabilities, generation speed, and inference cost.

🔗 Related reading: Just now, DeepSeek's new model suddenly launched, Flash's model, Pro's ambition

item.title: [两部门要求车企定期报告供应商账期，重点企业每年接受评估] Two Departments Require Automakers to Periodically Report Supplier Payment Terms, Key Enterprises to Undergo Annual Assessment
item.guid: 两部门要求车企定期报告供应商账期，重点企业每年接受评估
item.description:
The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) and the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) issued a notice on September 7, further standardizing how automotive companies pay suppliers for purchased goods, engineering, and services. Automakers are required to establish a supplier payment management system and submit semi-annual and annual performance reports by the end of July and the end of January of the following year, respectively.

MIIT will entrust a third-party institution to conduct an annual survey and assessment, covering all key automakers on the list. The assessment will involve reviewing company documents and data, verifying on-site conditions, and interviewing employees, focusing on information such as payment terms, payment methods and their proportions, and the scale of accounts payable. The results will be publicly released.

For automakers with large accounts payable, those who intentionally extend payment terms, or those with numerous complaints from small and medium-sized enterprises, the competent authorities will hold talks and urge rectification. Cases involving violations of laws and regulations will be handled according to law. Previously, the industry launched a '60-day payment term commitment' in 2025. This notice incorporates corporate reporting, third-party assessment, complaint verification, and law enforcement coordination into the normalized management process.

item.title: [小米中折叠「卖爆了」，首销较上代大折叠增长 310%] Xiaomi's Mid-Foldable 'Sells Out,' First Sales Up 310% Compared to Previous Generation Large Foldable
item.guid: 小米中折叠「卖爆了」，首销较上代大折叠增长-310%
item.description: Xu Fei, Vice President and CMO of Xiaomi Group, stated on September 8 that the first sales of the Xiaomi 18 Fold increased by 310% compared to the previous generation's large foldable. This mid-foldable phone was launched the previous evening with a starting price of 10,999 yuan, making it Xiaomi's highest-positioned smartphone product to date.

item.title: [曝微信 PC 版接入 AI 助手「小微」，可操作聊天与小程序] WeChat PC Version Reportedly Integrates AI Assistant 'Xiaowei,' Capable of Operating Chats and Mini Programs
item.guid: 曝微信-PC-版接入-AI-助手「小微」，可操作聊天与小程序
item.description:
WeChat has begun testing its AI assistant 'Xiaowei' in the PC version. It can view Moments, send messages, initiate voice and video calls, and answer questions about file content within chats; video files and scheduled messages are not yet supported.

'Xiaowei' can also invoke mini-programs to complete services like ordering food, and will require user confirmation when payments are involved. The 'Yuanbao Summary' entry in WeChat's built-in browser has also been replaced with 'Ask AI,' allowing users to continue asking questions about the current webpage.

Developer-facing capabilities include developing and debugging mini-programs on the PC, and generating trial versions. Personalized recommendations are off by default, but users can enable them separately in settings; currently, there is no option to disable the 'Xiaowei' entry point.

item.title: [蔚来与云南交投新一批高速换电站投运，覆盖 5 条高速双向服务区] NIO and Yunnan Communications Investment Group Launch New Batch of Highway Battery Swap Stations, Covering 5 Expressways with Bi-directional Service Areas
item.guid: 蔚来与云南交投新一批高速换电站投运，覆盖-5-条高速双向服务区
item.description:
NIO Energy and Yunnan Communications Investment Group announced on September 8 that their new batch of jointly built highway battery swap stations has been fully put into operation. The stations are located in the Disuoping service area on G5621 Kunchuda Expressway, Huize service area on G85 YinKun Expressway, Shizong service area on G78 ShanKun Expressway, Yuanmou service area on G5 JingKun Expressway, and Tongguan service area on G8511 Kunmo Expressway, with bi-directional deployment completed in all 5 service areas.

This marks a new round of operations for both parties following their first collaboration in 2024. The new stations connect major corridors in central, eastern, western, and southern Yunnan, filling gaps in high-speed battery swap nodes for cross-regional, long-distance journeys within the province. Both parties will also continue to promote high-speed "solar-storage-charging-swapping" integrated energy stations and zero-carbon service areas.

As of September 8, NIO stated that it has built 9328 charging and swapping stations, including 4075 battery swap stations and 5253 charging stations, equipped with 30284 charging piles; it has completed over 120 million battery swap services, with a total of over 200 million charging and swapping services.

item.title: [DeepSeek 新开约 150 个工程岗位，聚焦后端与 Agent 弹性计算] DeepSeek Opens Approximately 150 New Engineering Positions, Focusing on Backend and Agent Elastic Computing
item.guid: DeepSeek-新开约-150-个工程岗位，聚焦后端与-Agent-弹性计算
item.description:
Cui Tianyi, head of the DeepSeek Harness team, publicly announced the recruitment of approximately 150 people on September 7. These positions are primarily for engineers with 2 to 10 years of experience, but also accept fresh graduates and entry-level professionals; the main work location is Beijing, with some positions available in Hangzhou.

Recruitment is concentrated in two categories: server-side development and Agent elastic computing R&D. The former covers large model research platforms, Agent framework components, R&D efficiency infrastructure, DeepSeek API, online services, and data engineering; the latter includes platform development and maintenance, and underlying system optimization. This round does not list AI research positions separately.

Cui Tianyi explained that data, machines and containers, training and evaluation tasks, Agent environments, and user requests are all growing, requiring the existing backend system to be upgraded, maintained, or even rewritten. Previously in June, DeepSeek announced plans to at least double the size of each department; this recruitment focuses on a more concentrated range of positions.

item.title: [高通与亚马逊达成多代定制芯片合作，覆盖 AI 推理与 1.6T 光互联] Qualcomm and Amazon Announce Multi-Generational Custom Chip Collaboration, Covering AI Inference and 1.6T Optical Interconnect
item.guid: 高通与亚马逊达成多代定制芯片合作，覆盖-AI-推理与-1.6T-光互联
item.description:
Qualcomm announced on September 8 a multi-generational product collaboration with Amazon. The two companies will develop custom chips for AWS's large-scale AI data centers and jointly advance AI inference infrastructure. The partnership will also cover optical interconnects up to 1.6T and subsequent solutions.

Qualcomm will provide SerDes, optical DSP, low-power computing, and system integration capabilities to enhance high-bandwidth interconnects within data centers. Amazon will provide cloud AI infrastructure, with both parties aiming to create a scalable solution across computing, storage, network bandwidth, and energy efficiency.

Qualcomm also plans to expand its use of AWS AI infrastructure and Amazon Bedrock for electronic design automation workloads to shorten chip design cycles.

item.title: [《旅行青蛙·中国之旅》12 月 8 日停运，日文原版不受影响] "Travel Frog: China Tour" to Cease Operations on December 8, Japanese Original Unaffected
item.guid: 《旅行青蛙·中国之旅》12-月-8-日停运，日文原版不受影响
item.description:
"Travel Frog: China Tour" announced on September 8 that due to the expiration of its IP licensing agreement, the game will officially cease operations on December 8 at 18:00. As of 14:00 on the same day, download portals, top-ups, and new user registrations across all platforms have been closed.

After the cessation of operations, all account data and character information will be cleared. Paid clover obtained through top-ups within the last 3 months and not yet consumed can be refunded between September 8 and December 8. Official server users can submit requests via in-game customer service, while channel server and iOS users need to contact their respective channels.

The Chinese version was launched by Lingxi Interactive Entertainment in 2018 after obtaining authorization from Hit-Point. This cessation of operations only affects "Travel Frog: China Tour"; the Japanese original version "Tabikaeru" operated by Hit-Point remains in normal operation.

item.title: [Meta 发布个人 AI Agent Muse，可持续代办邮件、旅行和购物] Meta Launches Personal AI Agent Muse, Capable of Handling Emails, Travel, and Shopping Continuously
item.guid: Meta-发布个人-AI-Agent-Muse，可持续代办邮件、旅行和购物
item.description:
Meta launched its personal AI Agent, Muse, on September 8. Users can converse with it in a standalone app or WhatsApp, allowing it to break down goals, formulate plans, and continue executing tasks even after the user closes the application.

Powered by the Muse Spark model, Muse can open browsers, fill out forms, send emails, book travel, and complete shopping. It can also connect Meta products like Instagram with third-party applications, for example, organizing user-saved recipe Reels into a shopping list, or generating a menu based on guests' dietary preferences before a dinner party.

To isolate the Agent from user data, Meta configures a dedicated cloud-based Muse Secure VM for each Muse and employs a Sentinel, isolated from the main Agent system, to review external requests. Sensitive actions such as sending emails or making payments require user confirmation. Account passwords and payment information are stored in a separate secure area, inaccessible to Muse itself. Users can choose associated applications and permissions, and can also opt out of using interactions for model training.

Muse has been progressively rolled out to iOS, Android, and web users in the United States and will subsequently be available on Meta AI glasses. Basic features are primarily free, and Meta is also preparing subscription plans for high-intensity users.

item.title: [Robinhood 首次进入 IPO 承销团，参与 Oura 上市] Robinhood Joins IPO Underwriting Syndicate for the First Time, Participating in Oura's Listing
item.guid: Robinhood-首次进入-IPO-承销团，参与-Oura-上市
item.description:
According to the prospectus filed by smart ring company Oura with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Robinhood has joined its IPO underwriting syndicate, participating in the offering alongside institutions such as Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan Chase, Allen & Company, and Jefferies. The Wall Street Journal reported that this marks Robinhood's first official role as an IPO underwriter.

Robinhood began allocating new shares to retail clients in 2021 but previously primarily served a distribution role. By joining the underwriting syndicate, it can participate earlier in the offering arrangements and gain greater influence over the allocation reserved for its platform clients. Oura plans to list on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol "OURA," and the prospectus has not yet filled in the offering price and number of shares.

This arrangement also allows Robinhood to further enter traditional investment banking services from its position as a trading platform for retail investors. However, Oura's directed share program for employees and designated individuals is still managed by Morgan Stanley, and Robinhood's specific underwriting share has not yet been disclosed.

item.title: [Mistral 完成 30 亿欧元 D 轮融资，投后估值超 210 亿欧元] Mistral Completes €3 Billion Series D Funding, Post-Money Valuation Exceeds €21 Billion
item.guid: Mistral-完成-30-亿欧元-D-轮融资，投后估值超-210-亿欧元
item.description:
French AI company Mistral announced on September 8th the completion of a €3 billion Series D funding round, with a post-money valuation exceeding €21 billion. The company stated that this is the largest single round of equity financing completed by a European technology company to date.

This round of financing was led by Samsung Electronics, co-led by EQT-managed Scaleup Europe Fund and existing investor PSG Equity; Advent, funds managed by BlackRock, and the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg joined as investors, with existing shareholders such as ASML, NVIDIA, a16z, Bpifrance, and Salesforce Ventures continuing to follow on.

Mistral stated that the funds will be used for cutting-edge model research, training computing power, infrastructure expansion, and commercial and international business growth. The company currently operates in 20 countries, providing AI services to over 125 enterprises including Airbus, ASML, and HSBC.

item.title: [💡 梁琛奇：AI 娱乐产品要让消费过程实时使用算力] 💡 Liang Chenqi: AI Entertainment Products Should Utilize Computing Power in Real-Time During Consumption
item.guid: 💡-梁琛奇：AI-娱乐产品要让消费过程实时使用算力
item.description:
Liang Chenqi, former head of ByteDance's AI product team Flow, stated in an interview with "LatePost" that if AI entertainment products only reduce content production costs, the resulting short dramas, comics, or videos will still return to existing platforms; new independent platforms need to allow users to interact with models in real-time during the consumption process and obtain long-tail feedback that did not exist before.

He summarized the conditions for AI entertainment as cost, modality, and user habits. After DeepSeek-R1, inference costs continue to decrease; image and video models have crossed the usability threshold; and users have learned to interact with AI through products like ChatGPT and Doubao. Based on these changes, he believes that entertainment products can shift from static generation to generating images, videos, or gameplay while consuming.

Liang Chenqi's company, "Dongnian Yinxian," is simultaneously developing and testing seven or eight products, with small teams of one or two people creating demos within two weeks to a month, then deciding whether to shut down or add resources based on real user signals. Its first product, "Songguo Shike" (Pinecone Moments), can expand photos and text into multi-image stories with voiceovers, background music, and simple animations; the team's next step is to narrow content towards specific audiences and try to enable real-time model calls on the consumption side.

He believes that AI entertainment still cannot do without human subjective expression: models are good at generating a "sense of familiarity" based on user preferences, while true surprise and content diversity come from creators. A product needs to simultaneously be novel, long-term, high-frequency, and not easily tiresome, forming sustainable signals in retention and usage frequency.

item.title: [荣耀 Magic9 Pro Max 绿色外观曝光，后摄采用「1+2」转塔布局] Honor Magic9 Pro Max Green Appearance Leaked, Rear Camera Features '1+2' Turret Layout
item.guid: 荣耀-Magic9-Pro-Max-绿色外观曝光，后摄采用「1+2」转塔布局
item.description:
Renderings of the Honor Magic9 Pro Max in green were leaked on social media on September 8th. The image shows a body with a metal and back panel拼接 design, and the camera module features a "1+2" arrangement consisting of a large circle on the left and two smaller circles on the right; the left area also shows a periscope lens, flash, and ARRI logo.

This design is described as referencing the three-lens turret structure of ARRI ARRIFLEX cinema cameras. Honor has confirmed that its technical collaboration with ARRI will be applied to the next-generation Magic9 series, but the color scheme, body structure, and camera configuration shown in the leaked images have not yet been officially confirmed.

The same batch of leaks also listed specifications such as a 6.8-inch LTPO OLED flat screen, 3D facial recognition, dual 200-megapixel main cameras, and a periscope telephoto lens. These specifications remain unconfirmed information; the confirmable new points from this leak are primarily the green body and the turret-style rear camera layout.

item.title: [MagicOS 11 定档 9 月 15 日发布，主打系统级 Agent] MagicOS 11 Scheduled for September 15 Release, Featuring System-Level Agent
item.guid: MagicOS-11-定档-9-月-15-日发布，主打系统级-Agent
item.description:
Honor announced the schedule for its 2026 Global Developer Conference. MagicOS 11 will be released on September 15 from 19:00 to 20:00 in Shenzhen. The official positioning for the new system is the commercial implementation of a system-level Agent, with sub-forums on AI, gaming, and smart home to further introduce development capabilities.

Already announced system changes include a new liquid glass visual effect, lossless compression and redundant file cleanup, multi-protocol fast charging adaptation, and weak network optimization with AI-selected networks. Honor states that the overall smoothness of all series models will increase by more than 20%, and a 4K Live "shoot-while-recording" feature will be added.

Honor has not yet listed compatible models and specific upgrade batches. The developer conference will last one day, with the system release scheduled for the evening main forum.

item.title: [iQOO 16 与 iQOO Pad Ultra 定档 9 月底发布] iQOO 16 and iQOO Pad Ultra Scheduled for Late September Release
item.guid: iQOO-16-与-iQOO-Pad-Ultra-定档-9-月底发布
item.description:
iQOO announced that the iQOO 16 phone and iQOO Pad Ultra tablet will be released together at the end of September. Official teaser videos showcased the names and back designs of both products; the phone continues to use a square camera module, while the tablet features a centered matrix lens area.

Existing leaks suggest that the iQOO 16 will feature a 6.8-inch flat screen, the fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 processor, a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto lens, and a battery capacity possibly exceeding 7000mAh; the iQOO Pad Ultra may be equipped with a Dimensity 9600, a 14-inch screen, and a 16000mAh battery. These parameters have not yet been officially confirmed.

Certification information indicates that the iQOO 16 is expected to support 66W wired charging. iQOO will announce the full specifications and sales arrangements at the launch event at the end of the month.

item.title: [智象未来 vivago R1 全球上线，主打 5 分钟长视频生成] HiDream.ai vivago R1 Launches Globally, Specializing in 5-Minute Long Video Generation
item.guid: 智象未来-vivago-R1-全球上线，主打-5-分钟长视频生成
item.description:
HiDream.ai yesterday announced the global launch of its content creation AI intelligent agent vivago R1, with its domestic version "Gouda" simultaneously upgraded.

Official data shows that vivago.ai's global user base has now exceeded 70 million. Unlike the industry's mainstream 15 to 30-second short clip generation, vivago R1 focuses on long video creation, supporting stable output of 5-minute high-quality videos in one go, and possessing unlimited multi-round extension capabilities.

The product adopts a "Chat-First" mode, allowing users to drive video generation and modification through natural language conversations without needing to adjust complex nodes and parameters.

At the underlying architecture level, the product relies on its self-developed HD-AgentOS for task decomposition and multi-Agent collaboration. The official statement claims that the success rate of effective and usable content has increased to 85%, effectively alleviating the problem of inconsistent characters and scenes across different shots. vivago R1 is currently open for global users to experience.

🔗 Related reading: Hands-on with the globally launched vivago R1, I used it to create a cyberpunk Journey to the West short film

item.title: [9999 元，索尼发布首款全画幅鱼眼变焦镜头 FE 8-14mm F3.5 G] Priced at 9999 Yuan, Sony Releases its First Full-Frame Fisheye Zoom Lens FE 8-14mm F3.5 G
item.guid: 9999-元，索尼发布首款全画幅鱼眼变焦镜头-FE-8-14mm-F3.5-G
item.description:
Sony (China) Co., Ltd. yesterday officially released its first full-frame fisheye zoom G lens, the FE 8-14mm F3.5 Fisheye G (model: SEL814G).

This lens extends the wide-angle end of Sony's E-mount native lenses to 8mm, filling a product gap for Sony's full-frame fisheye lenses. The official suggested retail price is 9999 yuan, and it will be officially launched in mid-September.

item.title: [Xiaomi MiMo Desktop 开放邀测，可直接交付 PPT 和交互网页] Xiaomi MiMo Desktop Opens for Invitation-Based Testing, Can Directly Deliver PPTs and Interactive Webpages
item.guid: Xiaomi-MiMo-Desktop-开放邀测，可直接交付-PPT-和交互网页
item.description:
Xiaomi Technology announced on September 8th that the Xiaomi MiMo Desktop client is open for invitation-based testing. Users whose applications are approved can use the two new models, MiMo-X-Pro-Preview and MiMo-X-Flash-Preview, for free for a limited time and quantity during the testing period.

MiMo Desktop can receive various formats of materials, break down targets, and call tools, finally delivering editable results such as PPTs, Office files, webpages, and lightweight games. It supports previewing page interactions within a session, can operate Figma via MCP, or directly control browsers to retrieve, fill forms, and extract materials.

Users can select text, charts, or page areas within the results for partial regeneration, and each modification will retain version records. The built-in "Smart" mode dispatches between different models, Agents, and Skill paths based on task type and complexity; large tasks can also be split into multiple independent sessions for collaborative processing.

item.title: [WhatsApp 测试接入第三方 AI Agent，单个账号最多连接 5 个] WhatsApp Tests Integration of Third-Party AI Agents, Up to 5 Connections Per Account
item.guid: WhatsApp-测试接入第三方-AI-Agent，单个账号最多连接-5-个
item.description:
WhatsApp is developing a third-party AI Agent integration feature in its Android beta version. Users can create dedicated bot sessions within the app, where WhatsApp will generate an API Key. Users then enter this key into the corresponding Agent platform, allowing Agents running locally or in the cloud to directly receive commands and return results in the chat window.

Each account can currently connect up to 5 Agents, and users can set their names and avatars separately. Agents can only read content actively sent by the user to that dedicated session; they cannot access other chats, contacts, or media, and currently cannot join group chats or communities.

This feature is not yet widely available and is currently only offered to some Android users. It's important to note that third-party Agent sessions do not support end-to-end encryption at this stage; WhatsApp will also warn that AI replies may be inaccurate, and users need to verify the results themselves.

item.title: [面壁智能开源 MiniCPM5-2B，AA v4.2 评测位列 4B 以下开源模型第一] ModelBest AI Open-Sources MiniCPM5-2B, Ranks First Among Open-Source Models Under 4B in AA v4.2 Evaluation
item.guid: 面壁智能开源-MiniCPM5-2B，AA-v4.2-评测位列-4B-以下开源模型第一
item.description:
ModelBest AI released and open-sourced MiniCPM5-2B. This is a dense model with 2.6 billion parameters, scoring 15 on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index v4.2, ranking first among open-source weight models under 4 billion parameters collected by the organization.

MiniCPM5-2B supports a context of 131,000 tokens, uses the Apache 2.0 license, and can be deployed on mobile phones, tablets, and edge devices. The model card also provides pre-trained, supervised fine-tuned, reinforcement learning, and quantized versions, making it convenient for developers to use under different computational power conditions.

In Artificial Analysis's detailed tests, MiniCPM5-2B scored 831 points in GDPval-AA, 34 points in the combined Terminal-Bench Hard and τ²-Bench Telecom categories of the Agentic Index, and 438 points in the Briefcase Index. The 23 points cited in ModelBest AI's promotional materials are from the old v4.1.1 metric and cannot be directly compared with the current v4.2 score.

item.title: [ChatGPT Images 2.5 上线，新增草图生成与局部批注编辑] ChatGPT Images 2.5 Launched, Adds Sketch Generation and Local Annotation Editing
item.guid: ChatGPT-Images-2.5-上线，新增草图生成与局部批注编辑
item.description:
OpenAI released ChatGPT Images 2.5 on September 8. According to official sources, the new model significantly improves reference image subject fidelity, local editing precision, and multi-round modification consistency, with generation latency reduced by up to 50% compared to Images 2.0.

ChatGPT simultaneously added Sketch, template, and image annotation features. Users can input '@Sketch' to directly draw compositions or outlines, then use text to specify styles and details. They can also start creating from templates like posters or product photos, or leave modification annotations directly on generated images. The new version also supports including prompts when sharing images, making it convenient for others to replicate similar effects using their images.

Images 2.5 has been progressively rolled out to ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex users across desktop, mobile, and web platforms. For the API, GPT-Image-2.5 Flare and GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst have been introduced: the former is for high-frequency, fast image workflows, while the latter emphasizes high precision and multi-edit control. Generated images will still carry C2PA metadata and invisible watermarks.

item.title: [McKinley 1.0 发布，可直接设计并导出自定义 SF Symbols] McKinley 1.0 Released, Allows Direct Design and Export of Custom SF Symbols
item.guid: McKinley-1.0-发布，可直接设计并导出自定义-SF-Symbols
item.description:
McKinley 1.0, aimed at Apple developers and designers, has been officially released. It integrates vector drawing, symbol structure annotation, preview, and export into a single application. Users can import graphics from SVG or start from a blank canvas to create custom SF Symbols.

McKinley can reuse the same set of objects across various font weights, sizes, and color configurations, and calls Apple's renderer to preview results in real-time. Once designed, symbols can be directly exported to Xcode, eliminating the need to return to Apple's SF Symbols application to handle templates and annotations.

The product's official website states that the launch offer will last until noon BST on September 14.

item.title: [豆包博物馆讲解模式新增 12 种方言] Doubao Museum Narration Mode Adds 12 New Dialects
item.guid: 豆包博物馆讲解模式新增-12-种方言
item.description:
Doubao's museum narration mode has added 12 new dialects. Users can photograph exhibits within the museum, then select a dialect to receive audio narration. Doubao has also added new museum-related identity entry points for this mode.

This feature builds upon the museum narration mode launched in June this year. The first batch of collaborations covered over 20 museums, with Doubao selecting 5 exhibits for narration and collaborating with 7 cultural institutions on activities; the Shanghai Pudong Art Museum had already integrated 2 exhibits at that time.

With the addition of new dialects, the narration mode has expanded from identifying exhibits and generating background introductions to regionalized audio presentation. The specific list of supported dialects and covered museums is still subject to the Doubao client.

item.title: [《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》定档 11 月 5 日，登陆 Switch 2] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remastered Set for November 5 Release on Switch 2
item.guid: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛-重制版》定档-11-月-5-日，登陆-Switch-2
item.description:
Nintendo announced at The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct on September 8 that The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remastered will launch on November 5 for Switch 2, available in both digital and physical editions, with pre-orders now open. The first-run physical edition features special textured foil packaging and is available in limited quantities.

Series producer Eiji Aonuma demonstrated content such as towns, overworld exploration, combat, and music performance during the Direct. The remastered version retains the original's time travel and dungeon structure, while revamping graphics, controls, and some quality-of-life features.

Prior to the Direct, Nintendo Australia's eShop search results briefly showed a price of AU$94.95; Nintendo has now confirmed the release date and edition arrangements, but prices in other regions are still subject to local stores. The original game launched on Nintendo 64 in 1998, and this is one of the key titles Nintendo has prepared for the series' 40th anniversary.

item.title: [喜茶恢复合伙人申请入口，客服称尚未正式重启加盟] Heytea Restores Partner Application Portal, Customer Service Says Franchising Not Officially Restarted Yet
item.guid: 喜茶恢复合伙人申请入口，客服称尚未正式重启加盟
item.description:
The Heytea GO mini-program recently relaunched the 'I want to be a partner' entry point. This marks the first time the official application channel has reappeared since the brand suspended new franchise applications in February 2025. The entry point has also updated its application guidelines, adding risk warnings such as rational evaluation, prudent investment, and truthful submission of information.

Heytea customer service stated that partnership matters have not yet been officially reopened. Applicants can fill in their information first, and the brand will contact them once the program reopens; submitting an application does not imply an established partnership, and Heytea may reject applications that do not meet standards during the review process.

Heytea first launched its business partner model in November 2022. In early 2025, it suspended new applications citing 'rejection of meaningless scale internal competition' and began closing inefficient stores. The current change only confirms the restoration of the application portal; new franchising policies and opening times have not yet been announced.

item.title: [霸王茶姬在上海 7 家门店试卖茶叶蛋，单点 5 元] CHAGEE Trials Tea Eggs at 7 Shanghai Stores, Priced at 5 Yuan Each
item.guid: 霸王茶姬在上海-7-家门店试卖茶叶蛋，单点-5-元
item.description:
From September 7th to 21st, CHAGEE is trialing tea eggs at 7 stores in Shanghai. A single tea egg is priced at 5 yuan, or 2.5 yuan when purchased with a drink. The product is for dine-in only, and customers can enjoy a 20% discount if they purchase a set meal with a drink before 10:30 AM.

This trial is currently limited to Shanghai, including stores in commercial districts like MixC and Raffles City. CHAGEE has not announced whether it will expand to other cities, nor has it specified long-term plans after the trial period ends.

The brand had previously added food items to some stores for breakfast, afternoon, and evening hours. Tea eggs further introduce a common item from traditional convenience stores and breakfast shops into tea beverage stores, aiming to increase in-store consumption during off-peak hours.

item.title: [4 小时纪录片《马斯克》发布预告，10 月 16 日北美上映] 4-Hour Documentary 'Musk' Releases Trailer, Set for North American Release on October 16
item.guid: 4-小时纪录片《马斯克》发布预告，10-月-16-日北美上映
item.description:
The first trailer for Alex Gibney's documentary "Musk" has been released, premiering at the Venice Film Festival. The film, nearly 4 hours long, focuses on Elon Musk's business expansion, public influence, and personal conduct. The trailer includes both praise from supporters and sharp criticism from detractors.

Gibney previously won an Oscar for Best Documentary Feature for "Taxi to the Dark Side" and also directed "Enron: The Smartest Guys in the Room," "Going Clear: Scientology and the Prison of Belief," and the Steve Jobs documentary "Steve Jobs: The Man in the Machine." He stated that the new film will not simply label Musk as "good or bad," but rather examine how his power operates.

"Musk" will be released in North American theaters by Bleecker Street on October 16, then will be available on HBO and HBO Max. After Venice, it will also be screened at the Toronto Film Festival.

item.title: [《世界之巅》上线，回望世贸中心顶层餐厅的 25 年] 'Top of the World' Released, Looking Back at 25 Years of the World Trade Center's Top-Floor Restaurant
item.guid: 《世界之巅》上线，回望世贸中心顶层餐厅的-25-年
item.description:
The 40-minute documentary short "Top of the World" premiered on CNN on September 8th. The film, adapted from Tom Roston's non-fiction work and directed by Betsy West and Julie Cohen (directors of "RBG" and "Julia"), looks back at the 25-year history of Windows on the World, the restaurant on the 106th and 107th floors of the World Trade Center's North Tower.

The film begins with the restaurant's opening in the 1970s, documenting its ups and downs through stock market cycles, its recovery after the 1993 World Trade Center bombing, and the planned 25th-anniversary celebration in 2001. At the time, the restaurant had over 400 employees from more than 20 countries, speaking approximately 60 languages; several chefs, waiters, and managers share their experiences in the film.

During the 9/11 terrorist attacks, 79 employees and 91 customers of Windows on the World perished. The film previously had a limited release in New York from August 28th to September 3rd and is currently available for viewing via the CNN website and app.
